mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.created_at, u.username, u.display_name FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, body, created_at) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{body}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)) )
